findings.description: Hardcoding sensitive information such as device addresses can lead to security issues.
Using an uninitialized pointer can lead to undefined behavior, crashes, or even code execution vulnerabilities.
The code assumes that `attachBit.read()` will always succeed.
Reading device status without access control could leak information.
